description: Given two lists of integers representing sets, compute their symmetric difference (elements present in exactly one of the lists, not both). The input lists may contain duplicates and are unsorted. The result must be a sorted list of unique integers. Constraints: both input lists will contain between 0 and 1,000 integers, and all integers will be between -1000 and 1000. The solution should leverage vectorized set operations rather than nested loops.
python_solution:
import json

def solve(list_a, list_b):
    set_a = set(list_a)
    set_b = set(list_b)
    # Symmetric difference: (A union B) minus (A intersection B)
    result = sorted(list(set_a.symmetric_difference(set_b)))
    return result
